content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to simulate a mode with two masters instead of a master-slave setup? Could someone please share a sample project for master-slave configuration? Also, in which situations should one use VM or the slave module to handle data exchange? What's the main difference between master-master and master-slave, since both allow data transmission? Please address all these questions.

Yes, you can simulate both master-master and master-slave configurations using [product_name] programming software. You can download relevant application examples and documentation in *.zip format from [url].

I already have those files. However, in the master-slave example, it only includes the master program and lacks the slave setup, so I'm unable to configure it fully. I do not have any issues with master-master mode. I have three questions that remain unanswered and would appreciate assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for clarification and practical examples about configuring master-slave versus master-master communication modes using [product_name] programming software. There is confusion due to incomplete example projects, especially regarding the slave module setup. The need for comprehensive documentation and sample projects covering both communication roles is highlighted.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect thorough and complete sample projects demonstrating both master and slave configurations in master-slave mode, along with explanations outlining operational differences and guidance on when to utilize specific modules like VM or slave for data exchange.
